findings.evidence: Prefooter image has alt text 'Smartwatches' (`src="/sites/default/files/prefooter_images/yappmockup-pref.png"`), but it depicts a mobile app mockup rather than smartwatches.
findings.context: Screen readers will announce incorrect content for the app mockup image.
findings.impact: Minor accessibility confusion for visually impaired users relying on screen readers.
findings.recommendation: Update the alt text to accurately describe the Yettel app mockup.
